NAME:
   jf rt - Repository commands

USAGE:
   jf rt command [command options] [arguments...]

COMMANDS:
   ping, p   Checks that the server answers.
   curl, cl  Sends a request with the configured server details.

   Build Info:
     build-publish, bp            Publishes a build.
     build-add-dependencies, bad  Adds local files to a build
                                  as its dependencies.

   Files Management:
     upload, u     Uploads files.
     download, dl  Downloads files.

OPTIONS:
   --help, -h  show help
